landing.heroSubtitle: Receipts, purchases, and proof — organised automatically. The clearest way to see and act on what you actually spend.
landing.heroCaption: The place where your purchases live
landing.valuePropTitle: Turn everyday spending into clarity you can act on
landing.valuePropBody: Receiptify takes information that usually feels messy — receipts, purchases, expenses — and presents it in a way that just makes sense. So you spend less time figuring things out, and more time making smarter decisions.
landing.captureTitle: Snap any receipt. We do the rest.
landing.captureBody: Our AI reads every receipt and pulls out merchant, date, amount, currency and category — automatically. No typing, no guessing, no shoebox of paper.
landing.walletBody: All your receipts in one place — searchable, sortable, and ready whenever you need proof for a return, warranty, or expense claim.
landing.walletBullet1: Search thousands of receipts in seconds
landing.walletBullet2: Filter by merchant, category, or date
landing.insightsTitle: See where your money really goes
landing.insightsBody: Clean summaries replace messy dashboards. Spot patterns, set budgets, and make confident decisions based on what you actually spent — not what you thought you spent.
landing.insightsBullet3: Insights that fit on one screen
landing.diffSubtitle: Built for clarity and confidence — not complexity.
landing.diff1Body: Clean summaries, not endless dashboards. Just what matters, in plain language.
landing.diff2Body: Returns, warranties, expense claims — your receipts ready the moment you need them.
landing.diff3Body: AI handles capture, categorisation and currency — so you don't have to lift a finger.
landing.diff4Body: Any merchant, any payment, any country. Yours is the only wallet you'll ever need.
landing.whyBenefit2: Find anything you've bought in seconds
landing.whyBenefit4: Keep proof for returns and warranties
landing.finalCtaBody: Join thousands taking control of every purchase.

We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time, and your continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of any changes.
legal.termsServiceContent: Receiptify is a digital receipt management application that allows you to store, organise, and track your receipts electronically. Our service includes receipt scanning, categorisation, environmental impact tracking, and data export features. We strive to provide accurate and reliable services, but cannot guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation.
legal.termsAccountContent: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You must provide accurate and complete information when creating an account. You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorised use of your account or any other breach of security.
legal.termsUsageContent: You agree to use Receiptify only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these Terms. You may not use the service to upload, store, or transmit any content that is illegal, harmful, threatening, abusive, or otherwise objectionable. You may not attempt to interfere with or disrupt the service or servers connected to the service.
legal.termsIntellectualContent: The Receiptify service, including its original content, features, and functionality, is owned by us and is protected by international copyright, trademark,R and other intellectual property laws. You retain ownership of any receipts and data you upload to the service, but grant us a license to process and store this data to provide our services.
legal.termsLiabilityContent: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Receiptify shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including loss of profits, data, or other intangible losses. Our total liability for any claims arising from your use of the service shall not exceed the amount you paid us, if any, during the twelve months prior to the claim.
legal.termsChangesContent: We reserve the right to modify or replace these Terms at any time. If we make material changes, we will provide notice through the service or by other means. Your continued use of the service after such notice constitutes your acceptance of the modified Terms.
legal.termsContactContent: If you have any questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us at support@receiptify.app. We will respond to your inquiry within a reasonable timeframe.
legal.privacyIntroContent: At Receiptify, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our digital receipt management service. Please read this policy carefully to understand our practices regarding your personal data.
legal.privacyCollectionContent: We collect information you provide directly, including your name, email address, and receipt data. We also automatically collect certain information when you use our service, such as device information, usage patterns, and log data. Receipt images may be processed using optical character recognition (OCR) technology to extract text and data.
legal.privacyUseContent: We use your information to provide and improve our services, including storing and organising your receipts, generating analytics and environmental impact reports, and communicating with you about your account and updates. We may also use aggregated, anonymised data for research and service improvement purposes.
legal.privacyStorageContent: Your data is stored securely using industry-standard encryption and security measures. We use secure cloud infrastructure to protect your information from unauthorised access, alteration, or destruction. While we implement robust security measures, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
legal.privacySharingContent: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information with trusted service providers who assist us in operating our service, subject to confidentiality agreements. We may also disclose information if required by law or to protect our rights, property, or safety.
legal.privacyRightsContent: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. You can export your data at any time using our export feature. You may also request that we restrict processing of your data or object to certain processing activities. To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information provided below.
legal.privacyCookiesContent: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience and analyse usage patterns. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings. Please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of certain features of our service.
legal.privacyContactContent: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at privacy@receiptify.app. We are committed to resolving any concerns you may have about our privacy practices.
